description: Source code for a test tool handling pkt-line protocol, including packing, unpacking, sideband communication, and command dispatch.

methods.name: pack_line
methods.description: Handles special packet lines for flush and delimiter, or writes a line.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Reads input from arguments or stdin and packs lines.

methods.name: pack_raw_stdin
methods.description: Reads raw data from stdin and writes as a packet.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Reads packets and outputs their content, handling special cases.

methods.name: unpack_sideband
methods.description: Unpacks sideband packets with options for sideband use and newline chomp.

methods.name: send_split_sideband
methods.description: Sends multiple sideband messages, including divided messages.

methods.name: cmd__pkt_line
methods.description: Main command handler dispatching subcommands for packet line operations.
